data.name: Makena
data.gender_notes: Makena is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hawaiian culture, Makena means ‘graceful one’ or ‘gifted one’. This name is believed to be bestowed upon a child who is destined to bring joy and blessings to those around them. The name Makena carries the meaning “Gifted, graceful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Makena usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Makena total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: מקנה
in_hebrew.meaning: מקנה היא שם שפירושו 'מתנה של אלוהים' או 'מתנה'

in_greek.name: Μακена
in_greek.long_meaning: Μακена είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'δώρο' ή 'προίκα'. Το όνομα αυτό έχει σχέση με την έννοια της δωρεάς και της χάριτος. Στην ιστορία της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Μακена συνδέεται με την παράδοση της ορθοδόξου πίστης.
